name: english compact gate, four features
scope: English prompts only; French dev rows are scored for information and were not used

fit.estimator: L2 logistic regression, C=0.3, class_weight balanced, features standardised on the fit rows, lbfgs
commands: PIXEL_WEIGHT_FIXTURE=<fixture> PIXEL_WEIGHT_PROMPTS=<prompts.jsonl> PIXEL_WEIGHT_SPLIT=dev PIXEL_WEIGHT_OUT=<dump.json> cargo test -p pixel-daemon dump_the_raw_material -- --ignored

score: intercept_raw + sum(raw_coefficient[i] * feature[i]); a log-odds under a balanced prior, not a calibrated probability

features.name: struct_per_mille
features.definition: ln(1 + 1000 * structural_files / files_considered); 0 when files_considered is 0
features.why: how widely the prompt's rare words name files and symbols here, as a share of the repository (the same value at any size)

features.name: question
features.definition: 1 when the trimmed prompt ends with '?' or one of its first three words is in constants.question_words, else 0
sources: the typed prompt, pasted blocks removed
features.why: the shape of a question about the code

features.name: ops_share
features.definition: (number of keyword rows whose keyword is in constants.ops_vocab) / (number of keyword rows); 0 with no rows
features.why: git, release and CI operations are not code questions

features.name: struct_ratio
features.definition: B / Q, 0 when Q <= 0. B = the largest cofiles[].weight among co-files with structural true (0 if none); Q = the sum over keywords[] of row_weight(row), row_weight = 0 when row.common, else with df = max(content_files, symbol_files, filename_files): 0 when df * 4 > files_considered, IDF_CAP (4.0) when df is 0, else min(ln((files_considered + 1) / (df + 1)), 4.0)
features.why: how strongly the rare words, taken together, land on a file named for them

low.rule: high >= score > low: compact 'possibly related' brief; score <= low: none

thresholds.calibration: the 5 % and 10 % points of the pooled out-of-fold scores of the off-topic English dev rows (35 of them: at most 1 and 3 above); a prompt is above a threshold when its score is strictly greater

constants.words: lowercase runs of [a-z0-9_] in the prompt

edge_cases: no block, or a block without keywords (tokenize_task found nothing to search): the prompt is off, no score
the typed prompt has its <pasted_content ...>...</pasted_content> blocks (and an unclosed trailing one) removed before 'question' is read; the block must be computed from the same text
the fit rows all had graph: true; without a graph structural_files counts path matches only and the model should not be used
row_weight is pixel_daemon::relevance::row_weight; 'common' is the row's flag

information.note: the French rows are scored by the English model and were not used to fit or to calibrate
